hooks.name: audio-license-guard
hooks.description: Why: the Kiroween rules forbid third-party copyrighted music, and an unlisted audio file is the easiest way to break that. Effect: when a file is created or saved under assets/audio/, check that every audio file has a CC0 row with a source page in LICENSES.md; a mismatch is reported to the agent (exit 2). The same rule runs in tests/audio_license.test.js.

hooks.name: audio-license-guard-save
hooks.description: Same check when LICENSES.md or an audio file is saved.
